hypothesis: Intraday drift: long from the open to the close, every day
Gap continuation: after a gap > 0.3%, trade in the gap's direction open→close
Rebound: the day after a close-to-close fall > 1.5%, long open→close
Tuesday (weekly expiry): long open→close on Tuesdays
Turn of the month (last day + first 3): long open→close
After an India VIX jump > 10%: long the next day open→close
Volatility risk premium: India VIX minus the next 21 days' realised vol
note: in vol points ×100, not a return; harvested by selling options (margin)

Intraday momentum (Gao et al.): overnight + first hour predicts the last hour (14:15→close)
Late-day trend: trade the open→14:15 direction into the close
Opening-range breakout: first 5m close outside the 30-min range, hold to 15:15
VWAP reversion: > 2σ from VWAP, fade it for 30 minutes
30-minute momentum: trade the last 30 minutes' direction for the next 30
